And after this was spoken to me, the Spirit entered into me,
et statuit me supra pedes meos: et audivi loquentem ad me,
and he set me on my feet. And I heard him speaking to me,
mitto ego te ad filios Israël,
I am sending you to the sons of Israel,
ad gentes apostatrices quæ recesserunt a me:
to an apostate nation, which has withdrawn from me.
ipsi et patres eorum prævaricati sunt pactum meum usque ad diem hanc:
They and their fathers have betrayed my covenant, even to this day.
et filii dura facie et indomabili corde sunt,
And those to whom I am sending you are sons with a hard face
And you shall say to them:
Perhaps it may be that they will hear,
and perhaps they may be quieted.
For they are a provoking house.
et scient quia propheta fuerit in medio eorum.
And they shall know that there has been a prophet in their midst.

quoniam increduli et subversores sunt tecum,
For you are among unbelievers and subversives,
and you are living with scorpions.
You should not fear their words,
and you should not dread their faces.
For they are a provoking house.
Loqueris ergo verba mea ad eos,
you shall speak my words to them,
so that perhaps they may hear and be quieted.
